findings.evidence: Lines 451-457 define `Z`, `hFZ`, `hGZ`; the only uses of `Z` downstream are `hgood` (473-475, 482-484) and `hZle_f`/`hZle_g` (477, 486). Removing `W ⊓` changes nothing in those steps.
findings.fix: Use `Z := Zf ⊓ Zg` (plain `obtain`/`let`, dropping `with hZdef`), or, if `Z ≤ W` is meant to be load-bearing, state and use it; either way correct the docstring so the exceptional set `E = (F + G_Z) ∪ (F_Z + G)` is justified by what the proof actually does.
findings.issue: `set Z : OpenAddSubgroup A := W ⊓ Zf ⊓ Zg with hZdef`: the `W` component is dead — only `hZle_f : Z ≤ Zf` (452) and `hZle_g : Z ≤ Zg` (453) are ever used, no `Z ≤ W` fact is even stated, and neither branch (473-489) uses one. `hZdef` is also unused. Meanwhile the docstring (429-430) and the module narrative say the proof produces "one open subgroup `Z ≤ W` absorbs every bad coefficient", so the stated reason the proof works is not the reason it works.

findings.fix: Push the multiplication through `comap`: e.g. in `weightMul_absorb`, `exact (AddSubgroup.closure_le ((weightMul T (α+β) U).comap (AddMonoidHom.mulLeft a))).mpr (by rintro _ ⟨t, ht, z, hz, rfl⟩; ...) hb`, and likewise `mulRight` for the outer induction of `weightMul_mul_mem`. Each proof then reduces to its generator case.
findings.issue: The same `AddSubgroup.closure_induction` boilerplate (`zero`/`add`/`neg` closed by `simpa [mul_add]`/`[add_mul]`/`[mul_neg]`) is written three times: `weightMul_mul_mem` (206-221, nested, so eight cases), `weightPow_mul_weightMul_mem` (234-242), `weightMul_absorb` (336-343). Only the `mem` case carries content.

findings.issue: The antidiagonal case analysis is duplicated: `IsWeightedRestricted.mul` (466-489) and `weightedNhd_leftMul` (642-656) both run the identical good case (`weightMul_mul_mem`, `rw [hsum]`, `weightMul_mono ... ((AddSubgroup.closure_le _).mpr hWU)`) and the identical bad case (`weightMul_absorb ... ; rw [hsum]`). This is also what pushes `IsWeightedRestricted.mul` to 57 lines.

findings.evidence: `hZleZx : (W ⊓ Zx : OpenAddSubgroup A) ≤ Zx` (638) forces the `Z` of `weightMul_absorb` to be `(W ⊓ Zx).toAddSubgroup`; `weightMul_mono T ν (le_refl _)` is the identity on that subgroup by its statement at line 225.
findings.issue: `weightMul_mono T p.2 (le_refl _) (hg p.2)` is a no-op: `hg p.2` already has type `... ∈ weightMul T p.2 (W ⊓ Zx).toAddSubgroup`, which is exactly what `weightMul_absorb` needs (the absorbing subgroup is fixed to `(W ⊓ Zx).toAddSubgroup` by `hZleZx` in the preceding argument). The wrapper suggests a widening step that does not happen.

findings.evidence: `MvPowerSeries.X` is `def X (s : σ) : MvPowerSeries σ R := monomial (single s 1) 1` (Mathlib/RingTheory/MvPowerSeries/Basic.lean:374) with `theorem X_def (s : σ) : X s = monomial (single s 1) (1 : R)` at line 407.
findings.issue: `isWeightedRestricted_X` closes `IsWeightedRestricted T (MvPowerSeries.X i)` by `exact isWeightedRestricted_monomial T (Finsupp.single i 1) 1`, which typechecks only by unfolding the definition of `MvPowerSeries.X`; the explicit lemma exists.

summary: The mathematics is proved with robust tactics and no `change`/`show`, but the main proof's construction and its narrative disagree (the `W` component of `Z` is dead), the same four-case `closure_induction` boilerplate is written out three times where `closure_le` on a `comap` suffices, and the convolution case analysis is duplicated between `IsWeightedRestricted.mul` and `weightedNhd_leftMul`.
